strip: strip -x on staged copies; ad-hoc codesign
format: UDZO; HFS+; hdiutil create -srcfolder PAYLOAD -volname Runtime -format UDZO -fs HFS+ OUTPUT.dmg
scope: Build and payload-size experiment only; Fritz backend unchanged.

mistral_configuration.probe_contract: A local GgufModelBuilder::build plus TextMessages/send_chat_request path remains reachable through an optional runtime model path; no model path supplied during smoke check. Same context/max sequences/prefix-cache settings as Fritz.

reproduction.wrapper: Run all builds through python3 scripts/build-cache.py. Mistral build also sources scripts/compiler-cache.sh and calls configure_compiler_cache/start_compiler_cache.
reproduction.llama_build: cmake -S SOURCE -B BUILD followed by the llama_configuration options prefixed with -D; cmake --build BUILD --target llama --parallel 8
reproduction.llama_staging: Copy all build/bin/*.dylib preserving relative symlinks; compile the C++ probe with clang++ -O3 -arch arm64 -mmacosx-version-min=15.0, SOURCE/include and SOURCE/ggml/include, -lllama -lggml -lggml-base, and -Wl,-rpath,@executable_path. Remove absolute LC_RPATH entries from staged copies; give dylibs @loader_path. Strip and ad-hoc sign each regular Mach-O file.
reproduction.mistral_staging: Copy the release probe executable, strip -x, ad-hoc sign. Do not strip shared build-cache files.
reproduction.compressed_comparison: Same hdiutil create command for each payload; count regular files once, not dylib aliases. hdiutil verify passes for both images.

current_fritz_reference.note: Combined CLI, agent, chat and decision executable including ONNX. Not an isolated mistral.rs measurement and not replaced by the llama payload in this experiment.

verification: Every staged regular Mach-O file passed codesign --verify --strict.
llama C++ probe initialized a Metal GPU backend on Apple M2 Pro and reported two registered devices.
mistral Rust probe created a Metal device and reported Metal available: true.
Both HFS+/UDZO images passed hdiutil verify.
Both probes also executed successfully from their read-only mounted payload DMGs; llama initialized Metal and mistral created a Metal device.

llama_shader_compile_observation.note: Single backend-initialization run reported by ggml. Not a controlled cold/warm startup benchmark; excludes model loading and generation.

limitations: No Fritz integration or app replacement DMG was built. These are standalone payload DMGs, not full Fritz installer sizes.
Neither probe performed model inference; no weights were downloaded or personal providers contacted.
No model-quality, throughput, cancellation, tool parsing, prompt-template, or Bosun raw-logit equivalence conclusions.
llama shared libraries retain the C inference API and CPU/Metal backends but exclude common/server/tools; Rust bindings and any required higher-level adapters are not included.
mistral GGUF probe uses the current pinned dependency with its default features plus metal; this is not the experimental AFQ-pruned build.
Runtime Metal compilation can affect startup latency.
Only arm64 payloads were measured; system frameworks/libraries are excluded for both.
